mapper.select: SELECT plan_code FROM account_plan WHERE account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT id FROM account WHERE id = #{accountId} AND deleted_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO plan_usage_draft_program (account_id, source_code, source_program_id, created_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{sourceCode}, #{sourceProgramId}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO plan_usage_counter (account_id, feature, period_key, used_count, updated_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{feature}, #{periodKey}, 0, #{now}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE used_count = used_count
